Vague Words Make for A Vague Mind

One of the things that lead me to being red pilled was noticing low information persuasive language. Vague words, thought terminating cliches, and even humor are often used to turn people away from the truth or an uncomfortable idea. On one end you have terms like "no brainer" and the other you get "it's so weird you can't make it up". Both when you get down to it are vague, and not really saying anything besides this is how you should react.

Most people don't realize when they are even doing this and if you confront them on their vagueness, that they aren't saying anything, if they aren't willing to examine their preconceptions, they will get really defensive. Some will just be stuck with vague self affirming ideas.
